summary: NBA opening week dominates: Charlotte opens without Coby White and Kon Knueppel, Haliburton returns for Indiana, and Avdija is questionable for Portland. On Thursday night the Bears again expect to be without Monangai while the Patriots' backfield gets Henderson back at full practice.

CFB|5222671|ryd.note: Clear lead back for the nation's 8th-ranked rushing offense, 23 carries last week, facing a middling ECU run defense as a 10.5-point home favorite with the total rising.

detail.availability: Not on any injury list in previews; Memphis questionables are the backup QB and kicker, while ECU lists RB Ashton Gray and WR Jeremiah Melvin as questionable.
detail.role: Took 23 carries for 135 yards at Tulane and leads the team with 112 carries (16 per game) and 8 rushing TDs; Memphis averages about 238 rushing yards a game.
detail.matchup: ECU allows about 139 rushing yards a game (63rd nationally), roughly league-average, and just gave up 30 points to UAB.
detail.script: Memphis opened -9.5 and moved to -10.5 with the total up a point; a lead plus ECU's short possessions (26:57 time of possession, 132nd) favors a run-heavy second half after last week's six-turnover passing game.
detail.market: Consensus line 89.5 with books ranging up to 99.5 (FanDuel 89.5 at -114); his season average is 111 and he has cleared 89.5 in 5 of 7 games.
detail.experts: Previews single out Carter alongside Stokes and Tipton as the core of the Memphis offense; no injury or usage concerns raised.

NBA|4432573|ra.note: Black being out removes a ball handler, which could put more playmaking on Banchero, but no source quantifies a role change and the line already dropped from 14.5 to 13.5.

detail.availability: Banchero is not on the injury report.
detail.role: Anthony Black (ankle) is ruled out after missing all preseason; no replacement starter has been named.
detail.market: Line opened 14.5 and is now 13.5; no clear reason found for the move.

NBA|4066320|ra.note: Nothing found that changes Bane's role for the opener; Black's absence could add a little ball-handling for him, which argues against pressing the under.

detail.availability: Not on the injury report.
detail.role: Orlando is thin at guard with Black out.

NBA|2490149|3pm.note: McCollum starts at point guard, but a preview notes he may not reach 35 minutes; nothing concrete on his three-point volume.

detail.role: Starting point guard and Atlanta's second on-ball creator behind Jalen Johnson.
detail.market: Kalshi gives the over about 37%.
detail.experts: A betting preview likes his scoring, citing his 18-plus points per game with Atlanta last season and Orlando's weakened guard defense without Black.

NBA|4566434|pts.note: Wagner left the preseason finale with a right shoulder injury and the coach said he was still being evaluated after only light work; confirm he plays and has no limit.

detail.availability: Not on the posted injury list, but the shoulder was described as still under evaluation two days before the opener.

NBA|3032979|3pm.note: Coby White and Kon Knueppel are both ruled out of the opener, so Schroder is expected to step into the starting backcourt with far more minutes than a bench role; one made three clears the line.

detail.availability: Healthy. White (calf) and Knueppel (hamstring) are ruled out for the opener.
detail.role: He was acquired in August as White's backup. He is projected to start alongside Grayson Allen, and the packet shows him moved up to starter.
detail.script: The Nets are favored by 3.5 with a 219.5 total, a normal-paced game.
detail.market: Kalshi has the over at about 65%, above the 52.4% break-even. His assists line of 6.5 shows the book also expects starter minutes.

NBA|4395625|pr.note: Barrett carried the scoring in preseason, but Leonard's return adds a high-usage wing and a near double-digit spread brings blowout minutes risk; no clear edge either way.

detail.role: Scored 20 in a preseason win over the Clippers while Leonard sat; averaged about 18 points across four preseason games per a preview.
detail.script: Raptors -9.5 and rising; a lopsided game could cut starters' fourth-quarter minutes.
detail.market: Line moved up from 23.5 to 24.5, away from the over; points line around 18.5.
detail.experts: One preview leans toward Barrett's points over on preseason form and an expected heavy early workload.

NBA|2595516|ast.note: Chicago is short-handed (Claxton and Hawkins out), but Giddey runs the offense and nothing specific points to more creation from Powell.

detail.availability: Powell has no designation; Claxton (hamstring) and Hawkins (illness) are out.
detail.market: Kalshi about 56% over, above break-even, with no line move.

NBA|1966|pra.note: In his 76ers debut, LeBron shared the ball with Maxey, Brown and Embiid and finished with 30 PRA (14/9/7) in 34 minutes, under 30.5. His last-10 average of 37.2 reflects a bigger Lakers role.

detail.availability: Healthy. He played 34 minutes on Tuesday, and Thursday's game comes after one day of rest.
detail.role: He was introduced as the fifth starter and worked as a secondary initiator. He took 13 shots while Maxey led the scoring with 28.
detail.market: The line rose from 29.5 to 30.5, and the market's component lines (15.5 points) already show a smaller scoring role.

NBA|3917376|pr.note: Brown had 19 points and 8 rebounds (27 Pts + Reb) in the opener, clearing 25.5. Sharing usage with three other stars makes his Boston-era average of 32.2 an overstatement. No clear edge.

detail.role: He started and took a secondary scoring role behind Maxey, finishing with 19 points, 8 rebounds and 6 assists.

NBA|3202|pa.note: Durant is healthy and started the preseason opener (15 points, 2 assists in 23 minutes). VanVleet's return likely trims the assist load behind his last-10 average, and the line dropped from 28.5 to 27.5.

detail.availability: He sat the second preseason game by the coach's decision, with no injury reported.
detail.role: VanVleet is back running the offense, and Sengun had a triple-double in the preseason opener, so Durant's playmaking role from last season, played without VanVleet, may shrink.
detail.market: The line fell from 28.5 to 27.5. His assists line is 3.5, against a last-10 average of 6.6.

NBA|4432639|pra.note: Smith starts, but his last-10 average of 27.5 came without VanVleet, and Tari Eason is back as the first big off the bench. The book's component lines (12.5 points) suggest a smaller role. No edge either way.

detail.role: VanVleet's return and a healthy Eason add touches and frontcourt minutes that were not there for most of last season.
detail.market: The line is unchanged at 20.5, well under his last-10 average, which suggests the book expects a lower usage share.

NBA|3936299|reb.note: Murray is healthy and Strawther's absence trims Denver's guard depth slightly, but nothing points to a change in his rebounding role.

detail.availability: No injury concerns; scored a team-high 21 in the preseason finale.
detail.script: OKC -8.5; a lopsided game could cut starters' minutes.

NBA|4593803|3pm.note: Williams played in the opener (12 points on 5-of-16) after returning from injury; no minutes restriction was reported.

detail.role: Starting; described as returning in the opener; McCain's six threes show other shooters getting looks.

NBA|4278073|ast.note: Gilgeous-Alexander had 4 assists in the opener while scoring 32, and Kalshi is under 45% on the over; one game is not enough for a call.

detail.role: Took 27 shots in the opener and had 4 assists; McCain's six threes show secondary scoring off the bench.
detail.market: Kalshi 44% on the over, below the app; line steady at 6.5.

NBA|4066436|ast.note: With Podziemski out Melton should get extra guard minutes, but no source confirmed he starts or what his role will be.

detail.availability: Melton is not on the injury report; Podziemski (back) is out.
detail.role: Re-signed on a two-year deal in July; made 24 starts in 49 games last season at about 23 minutes.

NBA|4395628|ast.note: Dejounte Murray is expected back from a toe injury to run the offense, and Zion played 22 minutes in his last preseason game; no concrete sign his playmaking role is growing or shrinking.

detail.availability: Zion is not on the injury report.
detail.role: Mosley has pushed Zion to shoot more threes; nothing reported on his passing role.
detail.script: Indiana's coach expects a physical, fast-paced game.

NBA|4395712|ast.note: Haliburton is cleared and back as the lead playmaker, which cuts into Nembhard's assists, but backup point guard McConnell and Nesmith are out, which may keep his ball-handling minutes up.

detail.availability: Haliburton is off the injury report after playing the last two exhibitions (24 and 17 points); McConnell is also out, which keeps some backup handling with Nembhard.
detail.role: Haliburton, Nembhard, Siakam and Zubac were the projected core starters, with Nesmith out.
detail.market: Kalshi gives the over about 40%.

NBA|4277905|ra.note: Young played as a pass-first initiator in preseason, with 8 first-quarter assists in 23 minutes against Detroit. The line rose from 11.5 to 12.5, against the app's under. No clear edge.

detail.availability: No injury listed. Dybantsa (ankle) is out for Washington.
detail.role: In the Oct 10 preseason game he had 8 assists, all in the first quarter, over 23 minutes, and the coach praised his willingness to push the ball ahead.
detail.market: The line opened 11.5 and is now 12.5. That move runs against the app's under lean, and his last-10 sample comes from a disrupted 2025-26 season.

NBA|2528210|pr.note: Projected first guard off the bench as a spacer; Klay Thompson's cold preseason and Larsson's illness could open minutes, but nothing concrete on his minutes yet.

detail.availability: No injury designation for Hardaway; Larsson (illness) and Adebayo (groin) both expected to play.
detail.role: Previews project him as the first backcourt reserve signed for spacing next to Giannis and Adebayo; he went 4-for-4 in his preseason debut.
detail.script: Near pick'em with a 243.5 total, so no blowout minutes risk is priced in.
detail.market: Line opened 12.5 and is now 11.5, a move toward the over; no Kalshi price.

NBA|6475|3pm.note: Thompson went 3-for-20 from three in preseason, though Spoelstra backed his role and he stays in the lineup; slump alone is thin evidence.

detail.role: Starting at shooting guard; coach publicly supportive after the cold preseason.
detail.market: Kalshi near 50% on the over.

NBA|4066261|reb.note: Adebayo sat the final two preseason games with groin tightness; he expects to play but said he would be careful, so minutes could be trimmed. He is not on Miami's injury report for the opener.

detail.availability: Missed last two preseason games (right groin tightness); says he should be ready for the opener.

NBA|4683021|reb.note: Avdija is questionable with right ankle soreness and his status is unclear until shootaround; if he plays, minutes could be managed, but there is no basis for a confident call.

detail.availability: Listed questionable (right ankle soreness) on the official report; practice status not reported.
detail.role: Coach Nori calls him the centerpiece; Lillard and Morant now share the ball-handling.
detail.market: Book's no-vig chance on the over (53%) sits above Kalshi (43%); rebound line steady at 6.5.

NBA|4683021|pa.note: Questionable with ankle soreness, and Lillard and Morant returning to share creation; uncertain status means no support for his over.

detail.availability: Questionable, right ankle soreness.
detail.role: Lillard (back from Achilles) and Morant both start, adding ball-dominant guards.
detail.market: Current previews list his points at 21.5, a point below the packet's 22.5.

NBA|5105565|ra.note: Clingan starts at center; nothing new on his role beyond the projected lineup, though two ball-dominant guards may cap his assist chances.

detail.role: Projected starter at center alongside Lillard, Morant, Camara and Avdija.

NBA|5105565|3pm.note: No new information on his three-point volume this preseason; market already near the app.

detail.market: Kalshi 62.5% and book 61.7%, in line with each other.

NBA|3995|pra.note: Holiday comes off the bench behind Lillard and Morant and sat the preseason finale with hand swelling; the low line reflects that, though an Avdija absence could push him into the lineup.

detail.availability: Missed the preseason finale with right-hand swelling; X-ray negative.
detail.role: Bench role now that Lillard is back; likely starter at forward if Avdija sits.
detail.market: Current points line 12.5, well below his recent averages, which the guard-heavy rotation explains.

NBA|4066648|pr.note: Hachimura scored 21 in 15 minutes in his Clippers debut and led the team with 16 in the preseason finale, with Beal and Strus out. The line rose from 24.5 to 25.5, against the app's under. No clear edge.

detail.role: He is a starter and looked like a primary scorer in preseason, with Beal and Strus sidelined.
detail.matchup: Sacramento is missing big men Cardwell and Raynaud, which may open rebounds.
detail.market: The line rose from 24.5 to 25.5, against the app's under lean.

NFL|00-0036875|car.note: Stevenson is healthy and keeps the passing-down and goal-line work, but TreVeyon Henderson was a full practice participant Monday and Tuesday, so a three-way split with Kiner can cap his carries.

detail.availability: Not on the injury report; full participant status not in question.
detail.role: 60% snap share in Week 6 (41 snaps); Henderson fumbled and did not touch the ball again, while Kiner took 8 straight fourth-quarter carries as the hot hand.
detail.matchup: Chicago ranks 26th in yards per carry allowed to backs and 27th in explosive run rate; LBs T.J. Edwards and Jack Sanborn did not practice Monday or Tuesday, and Montez Sweat is suspended.
detail.script: New England is a 3-point underdog with a 23.75 implied total, so a trailing script could cut late carries.
detail.conditions: Mild, low wind at Soldier Field.
detail.market: Line fell from 11.5 to 10.5, which fits Kiner's emergence taking a share; book no-vig chance is about 49%.

NFL|00-0032464|rec.note: Raymond has only 7 catches over the last three games on route rates between 45% and 61%, and Burden, Loveland and Odunze lead the targets now that Williams is back.

detail.role: Two catches for 18 yards in Williams' return; Burden had 8 targets and Loveland 7.
detail.market: Kalshi and the book sit near 50% on the over.

NFL|00-0039918|cmp.note: Williams completed 30 of 36 in his return on a screen-heavy, short-throw plan, but the line already rose from 19.5 to 20.5 to reflect it.

detail.availability: Healthy and starting after missing Weeks 3 to 5.
detail.role: Screens on 22% of plays and a league-low 2.9 air yards per attempt last week.
detail.matchup: New England ranks 25th in completion rate allowed (66.2%).
detail.market: Line moved up a full completion since open.

NFL|00-0035676|recyd.note: Brown was limited Monday and Tuesday with the ankle, though he says he will play; he drew a third of targets in his return but caught 3 for 27 with two drops.

detail.availability: Limited both days on the official report; told reporters he is good to go.
detail.role: Ran a route on 97% of dropbacks with 10 targets in Week 6.
detail.matchup: Chicago allows a league-high 11.8 yards per target to outside receivers.

NFL|00-0040734|car.note: Henderson lost a third-quarter fumble and never touched the ball again as Kiner took over late work; he played only 24% of snaps.

detail.availability: Full participant with an ankle note on the official report.
detail.role: Seven carries on 16 snaps in Week 6; Vrabel cited riding the hot hand with Kiner.

NFL|00-0036275|td.note: Monangai is doubtful again, leaving Swift as the lead back for an offense with the league's highest share of rushing touchdowns; he scored twice last week.

detail.role: Swift played 77.5% of snaps and had 18 of 25 backfield touches through three quarters in Week 6; Roschon Johnson also scored late.
detail.matchup: Chicago's implied total is 26.75; 72% of its touchdowns have come on the ground.
detail.market: Shortest anytime price in the game (about 59% implied), so the edge over the market is small.

NFL|00-0036875|td.note: Stevenson is described as New England's top goal-line option, but Kiner and Henderson are both getting carries and the line is patched, so no edge over the roughly 47-49% market price.

detail.role: Holds passing-down work (15 routes, 11 pass-block snaps last week) and goal-line priority.
detail.matchup: Chicago allows 4.4 yards per carry to backs (26th).
detail.market: Kalshi 46.5%; best book price about +105.

NFL|00-0040236|td.note: Monangai has not practiced since his Week 4 toe injury, missed Weeks 5 and 6, and is listed doubtful; Swift and Roschon Johnson handle the backfield.

detail.availability: DNP Monday and Tuesday on the official report; coach called it week to week.

NBA|3975|reb.note: Curry sprained his right ankle in Sunday practice but practiced fully Monday and Kerr says he will play; no minutes limit reported, so nothing moves his rebounding.

NBA|4066457|pr.note: Golden State is without Podziemski, Porzingis, Butler and Moody; nothing found that changes Reaves' role for the opener.

NBA|4066648|pra.note: With Beal and Strus out, Hachimura stays a main scoring option after leading the Clippers in preseason; nothing found that argues for the under.

NBA|3032976|reb.note: No injury or role news found for Gobert ahead of the opener in Miami; nothing beyond the numbers.

NBA|4432165|ast.note: Anthony Black is out with an ankle sprain, removing a ball handler, which leans slightly against an assists under for Suggs; no source quantifies his role.

NFL|00-0039919|rec.note: Odunze shares the target lead with Burden and Loveland in a short, screen-heavy passing plan; nothing concrete beyond the numbers.

CFB|5165807|pyd.note: Memphis is a double-digit home favorite with the total rising to 54.5; no injury or role news found for Stokes.

CFB|5075800|pyd.note: Williams appears to be a recent starter with 341, 143 and 126 yards in his last three games, so his season average understates him; not enough to back the under.

NBA|4066648|pts.note: With Beal and Strus out, Hachimura stays a main scoring option after leading the Clippers in preseason; nothing found that argues for the under.

NBA|4433247|3pm.note: Kuminga is not on the injury report for the opener; Minnesota's only listed absence is DiVincenzo (out), which removes a perimeter shooter but no source confirms more threes for Kuminga.

NBA|4278053|3pm.note: Mitchell is not on Miami's injury report (only Goldin is questionable); nothing found that changes his role or three-point volume for the opener.

NBA|3032977|pra.note: Giannis is not on Miami's injury report for his Heat debut; no minutes limit reported, so nothing here supports pressing the under beyond the numbers.

NBA|4997536|reb.note: With Porzingis, Butler and Moody out, Santos is in line for a bigger frontcourt role (he started a preseason game against the Lakers), which argues against the under.

NBA|4701230|pra.note: Johnson is not listed for Atlanta, whose absences are frontcourt reserves Gueye and Veesaar; nothing found that limits his role, so the under rests on the numbers alone.

CFB-week.summary: Only four small-conference midweek games fall in the window (NMSU at Sam Houston Wed; JMU at App State, Liberty at Kennesaw State, ECU at Memphis Thu), and as of Wednesday the reputable odds pages post player props only for ECU at Memphis. Memphis is coming off a six-turnover loss at Tulane but still leads FBS-level offenses in rushing volume, and the market has moved toward the Tigers (-9.5 to -10.5, total 53.5 to 54.5).

NBA-ATL-at-ORL-1021.summary: Season opener in Orlando with the Magic about 3.5-point favorites and a 236.5 total. Orlando is without Anthony Black (ankle), Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Izaiyah Nelson, and Franz Wagner was still being evaluated for a right shoulder issue from the preseason finale. Atlanta's only notable absences are bigs Veesaar and Gueye.

NBA-CHA-at-BKN-1021.summary: Charlotte opens shorthanded: Coby White (calf), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), Grant Williams and Kylan Boswell are out, which pushes Dennis Schroder into the starting backcourt with Grayson Allen. The Nets are 3.5-point favorites, moved from an opening Nets +4.5, and the total is 219.5.

NBA-CHI-at-TOR-1021.summary: Toronto opens at home as a 9.5-point favorite (opened 8.5; total 236.5 from 235.5) with Kawhi Leonard making his regular-season debut after a cautious preseason ramp-up; Brandon Ingram is out. Chicago is thin up front with Nic Claxton out (Jalen Smith starts) and Jordan Hawkins out ill.

NBA-CLE-at-PHI-1022.summary: Philadelphia beat the Knicks 106-100 in the opener with four stars sharing the ball: Maxey had 28 points, Brown 19 points and 8 rebounds, LeBron 14/9/7 in 34 minutes, and Embiid 13/11/6. The app's last-10 averages for LeBron and Brown come from their old teams, where each carried more usage. Cleveland has Harden and Mitchell together.

NBA-DAL-at-HOU-1022.summary: Fred VanVleet is back from the ACL tear that cost him all of 2025-26: he had 17 points and 7 assists in the preseason opener against Dallas. Tari Eason is healthy as the first player off the bench. The app's last-10 numbers for Durant and Jabari Smith come from games without VanVleet, so their playmaking and touches could shrink. Dallas is missing Lively, Aldama and Martin.

NBA-DEN-at-OKC-1023.summary: OKC's home opener after a 116-104 win at San Antonio; the Thunder are 8.5-point favorites. Denver is missing Julian Strawther (six weeks, knee), so Tyus Jones takes backcourt minutes; Jokic and Murray had no injury concerns in preseason. In the opener, Jared McCain hit six threes and Jalen Williams went 5-of-16 in his return.

NBA-GS-at-LAL-1022.summary: Golden State opens short-handed: Podziemski, Porzingis, Butler and Moody are out, and Curry is probable after an ankle sprain in Sunday practice, with Kerr saying he will play. The Lakers list Collin Sexton as questionable.

NBA-IND-at-NO-1022.summary: Tyrese Haliburton returns for his first regular-season game since his 2025 Finals Achilles tear and is not on the injury report; the packet's Indiana starters omit him. McConnell and Nesmith are out, so Kelly Oubre Jr. likely fills wing minutes. Dejounte Murray is expected back from a toe contusion for New Orleans under new coach Jamahl Mosley.

NBA-MIL-at-WSH-1021.summary: Season opener in Washington. The Wizards are without No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa (ankle) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), and Trae Young now plays next to Anthony Davis on a much deeper roster. Young leaned into passing in preseason. Nothing found shifts the Reb + Ast line clearly either way.

NBA-MIN-at-MIA-1021.summary: Season opener in Miami, near pick'em (Heat -1.5, total 243.5, no visible move). Bam Adebayo missed the last two preseason games with groin tightness but expects to play; Pelle Larsson has been ill for about two weeks but is expected to play; Klay Thompson shot 3-for-20 from three in preseason but keeps his starting spot per Spoelstra.

NBA-PHX-at-POR-1022.summary: Portland opens as a 2.5-point favorite (total 231.5) with Damian Lillard back from his Achilles and starting next to Ja Morant. Deni Avdija is questionable with right ankle soreness; if he sits, Jrue Holiday likely joins a three-guard lineup and Vit Krejci gets more wing minutes. Holiday comes off the bench and sat the preseason finale with hand swelling (X-ray negative).

NBA-SAC-at-LAC-1022.summary: The Clippers start without Bradley Beal (knee), Max Strus (plantar fascia) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser. Rui Hachimura was their top scorer in preseason. Sacramento is thin up front without Cardwell and Raynaud, and Monk is questionable.

NFL-NE-at-CHI-1023.summary: Caleb Williams returned last week from a three-game absence in a screen-heavy, quick-passing plan. Chicago is a 3-point favorite with a 26.75 implied total and Kyle Monangai again doubtful, so Swift leads the backfield. New England's line is patched (Ben Brown and Vera-Tucker doubtful, Moses limited), and its backfield split three ways last week after Henderson fumbled and Kiner took fourth-quarter work.

fix.summary: Quick checks on Top 10 picks not covered by the batch researchers.

NBA-OKC-at-SA-1021.summary: Mitch Johnson confirmed a three-guard start (Fox, Castle, Harper with Vassell and Wembanyama), so Julian Champagnie is not starting as the packet assumed; Tobias Harris (calf) is out. OKC returns its core with Jalen Williams and Ajay Mitchell healthy, but Dort, Joe and Wiggins are gone, opening more minutes for Wallace, Mitchell and McCain.

best.why: Carter is Memphis' clear lead back with 23 carries for 135 yards and 19 for 132 in his last two games, and no injury news. ECU's run defense ranks mid-pack, and Memphis is a 10.5-point home favorite with the total moving up, which points to steady volume.
